sec: sec:E006: Conduct vendor due diligence / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:E006: Conduct vendor due diligence / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Defining assessment criteria for foundational or upstream AI models. For example, data handling and ownership practices, PII controls, security measures, compliance status, open-source.

sentences.text: Defining assessment criteria for foundational or upstream AI models.
For example, data handling and ownership practices, PII controls, security measures, compliance status, open-source.

blocks.id: blk:E006: Conduct vendor due diligence / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Conducting documented assessments. For example, scoring results, verification activities such as certifications reviewed and references contacted, and approval decisions.

sentences.text: For example, scoring results, verification activities such as certifications reviewed and references contacted, and approval decisions.

blocks.id: blk:E006: Conduct vendor due diligence / Control shoulds/3
blocks.text: Maintaining assessment records with sufficient detail for audit purposes and retaining due diligence evidence before vendor approval.
